summary: Validated end-to-end the VPOS_MULTIRIF 'Enviar a Implementación' bug fix. FRONTEND: With quote COT-2026-06-068-PYME (quo_260f2aa66422, VPOS_MULTIRIF, status=Borrador) clicking 'Enviar a Implementación' triggers (a) Alerta de Flujo Irregular modal (expected since quote needs Pagada), (b) Personalizar Comunicación modal, and after Continuar (c) opens the multistore wizard DIRECTLY on the Pinpads phase: data-testid='pyme-pinpad-question-phase' visible=True, the heading '¿La implementación requiere Pinpads?' is shown with 'Paso 1 de 3' label. NO '¿El Proyecto es Multitienda?' modal appears (count=0). The 'Atrás' button (pinpad-question-back-btn) CLOSES the wizard cleanly for VPOS_MULTIRIF (verified by checking the pinpad phase is no longer visible after click), confirming no navigation to non-existent 'collect'/'ask' phases. BACKEND: pytest tests/test_ficha_multirif.py 2/2 PASS and a live curl to GET /api/projects/prj_e586608e3579/ficha-tecnica returns HTTP 200 application/pdf (5239 bytes). pypdf extraction confirms the PDF contains 'DETALLE DE TIENDAS Y SUCURSALES', 'Multi-RIF' label, the 3 RIFs (BRASERO, BARAKO, CARBON), and 'TOTAL GENERAL 28'. Bug-fix verified.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>' / '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>' caused by <span data-ve-dynamic style='display:contents'> wrapper around <tr>. Documented in iterations 70-72; NOT related to this fix.

action_items: None blocking for this fix. (Optional pre-existing) Remove the <span data-ve-dynamic> wrapper around <tr> in QuotesTable.jsx to remove the React hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Quotes.jsx openMultistoreDialog (line 2696) correctly branches on quote_type==='VPOS_MULTIRIF': sets is_multistore=true, projectTypeImpl='vpos_mpos', multistorePhase='pinpad_question' and RETURNS WITHOUT calling handleSendToImplementation (no early-return-to-direct-send). The fix correctly preserves the wizard.

QuoteModals.jsx pinpad_question phase Back button (line 837-848) checks getMultistoreQuote()?.quote_type === 'VPOS_MULTIRIF' and closes the dialog via setMultistoreDialogOpen(false) instead of routing to non-existent 'collect'/'ask' phases — correct.

Regression NOT introduced for non-multirif quotes: openMultistoreDialog still sets isMultistore=null and triggers handleProjectTypeSelect(inferred) for VPOS/MPOS/GATEWAY/FAST_TRACK paths (visible at lines 2738-2751).

Backend services/implementation_pdf.py _build_multirif_table correctly renders Cliente(RIF) -> Sucursales -> Cajas hierarchy and emits a 'TOTAL GENERAL' row — confirmed in extracted PDF text from prj_e586608e3579.
Backend routes/projects.py download_ficha_tecnica constructs multirif_distribution from project.rifs + project.stores — verified on live data (3 RIFs, 28 cajas).
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing quo_260f2aa66422 (VPOS_MULTIRIF Borrador, 50 cajas, 3 RIFs) and prj_e586608e3579 (multirif project, 28 cajas).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug-fix VALIDATED. Selectors verified: data-testid='pyme-pinpad-question-phase' (wizard step 1 for VPOS_MULTIRIF), 'pinpad-question-back-btn' (closes wizard for VPOS_MULTIRIF; navigates to ask/collect for non-multirif), 'pinpad-no-btn'/'pinpad-yes-btn'/'pinpad-yes-other-btn', 'consolidated-data-phase', 'confirm-implementer-phase', 'confirm-implementer-advance-btn'. To reach the wizard for quo_260f2aa66422 (still Borrador), the flow sequence is: action menu -> 'Enviar a Implementación' -> Alerta de Flujo Irregular modal (fill motivo + date 'input[type="date"]') -> Confirmar Acción -> Personalizar Comunicación modal -> Continuar -> wizard opens at pinpad_question. Note: the date input in the Irregular modal shares CSS selector input[type=date] with the page-level Desde/Hasta filters, so do not loosely target it after closing — use a scoped locator within the modal. End-to-end completion of the wizard (to actually create the project) would require quote to be Pagada (backend rule).
rca of the issue: Previous bug: openMultistoreDialog had an aggressive bypass that for VPOS_MULTIRIF called handleSendToImplementation directly with an early return, skipping the entire technical wizard. Fix applied in Quotes.jsx (~L2725) routes VPOS_MULTIRIF to multistorePhase='pinpad_question' with is_multistore=true preset, AND in QuoteModals.jsx pinpad_question Back handler (~L837) closes the wizard for VPOS_MULTIRIF instead of navigating to phases that no longer exist for this flow. Both changes are present and behave correctly under live test.
